evidences.title: Readers put themselves on the cover for #bookfacefriday  in pictures | Books | The Guardian
evidences.content:
After the New York Public Library called for readers to share their #bookfacefriday pictures theyve been covering themselves with glory. Check out some of our favourite book cover selfies  can you beat them? Join in by clicking on the blue Contribute button, or post them on social media with the hashtag #bookfacefriday

Marta Bausells
